title: Issue with Inaccurate Distance Tracking in Tunnels
body:
Dear Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I’m writing to report a recurring issue I’ve experienced while using your app to track my cycling sessions.

I’ve noticed that whenever I cycle through tunnels, the app fails to register the kilometers covered during that portion of the ride. This results in inaccurate distance tracking and affects the overall statistics and performance data. As someone who frequently cycles in areas with tunnels, this significantly impacts the reliability of the app for my training and progress monitoring.

I understand that GPS signals may be limited in enclosed spaces, but I believe there could be a way to estimate the distance based on speed and time, or to implement a feature that compensates for these gaps.

I would greatly appreciate it if your team could look into this issue and consider a solution in future updates. Thank you for your attention to this matter, and I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Jens
